payload.because: Single source of truth makes itinerary editing (phase 4) a matter of inserting/soft-deleting day rows; the today rule agrees with a strict per-zone match whenever that match is unique, and never reports null mid-trip. payload.chose: Trips API shape: POST /api/trips 201 → trip {id, title, start_date, end_date, nights, legs:[{city_id,nights}], days:[{index,date,city_id}], from_bucket_id|null, created_at, updated_at}; GET /api/trips → {trips} (start_date, id order); GET/DELETE /api/trips/{id} (DELETE soft → {deleted:{type:"trip",item}}, undoable); GET /api/trips/{id}/today → {day_index|null}.
